title: Curiosity Killed The Bird But Satisfaction Brought It Back
gallery_text: I made a bird with math. I documented factories with photographs. The methodological curiosity is what connects them.

answers.interest: I’m working on documentation and mapping research, and I’m curious about how models, simulations, and spatial representations can be hacked to make systems visible and investigate their transformations.
answers.suggestions: Not yet! I’m still very new to this methodology, but eager to follow my curiosity — although hopefully it doesn’t have to kill the bird. :(
